description.value: John's Place is a beloved Victoria institution that has been serving scratch-made breakfast and lunch for over 40 years from its downtown Pandora Avenue location. The kitchen makes everything from scratch — including herb bread, cornbread, and all salad dressings — and gained national attention when Food Network Canada featured it on 'You Gotta Eat Here,' showcasing dishes like Eggs Benedict with real-butter hollandaise and Belgian Waffles. A touring cyclist rolling into Victoria will find a relaxed, diner-style room and hearty Canadian comfort fare to fuel the next leg.
